summary: Consumes the next character from a stream buffer. Decrements the remaining-count value pointed to by the pointer stored at this+0x30, reads the current character through the position pointer stored at this+0x20, then advances that position pointer by 2 bytes so the next call returns the following character. Returns the character value read before the advance. Invoked by sub_599ED6 (0x00599ED6).

local_names.this: stream buffer object holding a position pointer at +0x20 and a remaining-count pointer at +0x30

operations.description: Decrements the value pointed to by the pointer stored at this+0x30 (this[12]) — the remaining-character count
Loads the position pointer v1 from this+0x20 (this[8]) and reads the current character value result = *v1
Advances the position pointer stored at this+0x20 by 2 bytes (*v1 += 2) so the next call reads the following character
Returns the character value read before the pointer advance; the function is invoked by sub_599ED6 (0x00599ED6)
